'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – The Nameless Terror''''' is a comic miniseries that published as part of Phase II of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. The series was written by [[George Mann]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]].
